steps: A sweet cream base is poured onto an ice-cold steel plate.
Fruit, cookies or candy get chopped right into the base.
It is spread thin so it freezes in seconds.
A spatula scrapes it up into tight, creamy rolls.
The rolls stand up in a cup and get finished with toppings.
why: Every cup is mixed, spread and rolled on the plate while you watch.
Toppings are chopped into the base, not just sprinkled on top.
Each order starts fresh on a frozen plate, made to order.
